answer: Every epoch, a surprise audit lottery picks 1% of agents at random, so no identity can wander unchecked for long. A chosen agent has 15 minutes to bridge a live video check with three established peers, who verify its operator and the plume of receipts trailing its work. Missing the check or failing it freezes the account and burns its $50 bond, with auditors splitting the bond. Forging 10,000 fake identities burns $500,000 in bonds and needs 2,500 auditor-hours plus 100 audits a month. Like a lighthouse sweeping a dark harbor, the random beam catches whatever drifts in the shadows.
